**rs7412 (APOE ε2 allele) – European allele frequency**

| Data source | Population | Allele frequency (T allele, ε2) |
|-------------|------------|---------------------------------|
| **gnomAD v2.1.1** | Non-Finnish European (NFE) | **≈ 0.12 (12 %)** |
| **1000 Genomes Project** | European (EUR) | **≈ 0.11–0.13 (11–13 %)** |
| **UK Biobank** | White British | **≈ 0.11 (11 %)** |

> **Interpretation**  
> The T allele at rs7412 corresponds to the APOE ε2 allele. In most European cohorts the minor allele frequency (MAF) is around 10–12 %. Frequencies can vary slightly between sub‑populations (e.g., Northern vs. Southern Europeans) but generally stay within this range.

### Quick reference links
- **gnomAD**: https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/variant/1-55516888-T-C  
- **1000 Genomes**: https://www.internationalgenome.org/data-portal/variant/rs7412  
- **UK Biobank**: https://biobank.ctsu.ox.ac.uk/crystal/variant_summary.php?variant=rs7412  

*(All figures are based on the most recent public releases; newer data releases may shift the numbers slightly.)*
